title: Endpoint beacon contract suite: CI-backed semantic conformance for streaming + tool-calls
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a lightweight, CI-friendly contract test suite (the 'beacon' suite) that verifies semantic compatibility across streaming endpoints, function/tool calling, and structured-output paths. The suite should detect regressions that affect client-visible semantics (field names, event ordering, final JSON payload validity, tool-call invocation shape) and fail PRs early while running a fuller matrix nightly. The goal is preventing customer-impacting API drift without long PR wait times.
acceptance_criteria: PRs running the quick beacon checks must block merges if critical semantic assertions fail
Nightly matrix executes streaming x function-call x structured-output permutations and reports failures to SLO dashboard
False-positive rate under 2% on a 2-week rolling window after initial tuning
Automated triage links failing seed to reproducible golden-seed and a suggested rollback or mitigation
Test cases cover backwards-compatible fallbacks: ndjson partial responses, interleaved tool-call events, and prefix/KV cache priming scenarios
design_notes: Use small deterministic golden seeds (<= 4 requests) for PR checks to keep runtime low
Nightly full-matrix will increase sequence lengths and inject non-determinism to find regressions in batching/kernel selection
Prefer semantic assertions (event type, tool invocation payload, top-level JSON schema) over brittle token-level diffs
Capture and fingerprint ordering invariants; allow acceptable reordering within a documented tolerance window
Record minimal canonicalized payload for each golden seed to ease triage (strip timestamps, ephemeral ids)
We trade some coverage on very-long-context cases for faster feedback in PRs; long-tail tests live in nightly/weekly jobs
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Implement beacon harness and integrate with PR pipeline (fast seeds + schema checks)
Phase 2: Add nightly full-matrix orchestrator that runs against main runtime branches and stores artifacts in S3
Phase 3: Build triage UI that links failing seed -> failing run -> failing PR + suggested mitigations
Phase 4: Run 2-week burn-in to tune flaky thresholds and reduce false positives
Phase 5: Add optional production-seeded fuzz corpus and integrate with SLO alerts
progress_updates: 2025-02-21: Kickoff sync with PM and QA. Agreed on 'beacon' name and high-level gating strategy (fast PR checks + nightly matrix)

2025-02-24: Prototype harness for streaming + function-call in python runner. Demonstrated schema assertions against prerecorded model responses. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/beacon-proto/pull/3
2025-02-27: Decided to canonicalize payloads by removing volatile fields (request_id, timestamp) and normalizing whitespace before fingerprinting

2025-03-01: Integrations spike found an intermittent ordering difference when running with continuous batching on latest runtime; created ENG-33102 (follow-up) to surface kernel scheduling nondeterminism

2025-03-03: First CI integration in place for fast seeds. Two PRs blocked by tests; both had regressions in tool-call event framing. Linked fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2148
Notes: Luis will own nightly matrix infra; Maya will own PR harness and triage UI skeleton
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Flakiness from non-deterministic scheduling can cause noisy CI failures. Mitigation: run seeds with a small fixed random seed for PRs and capture artifact to debug nightly failures
Risk: Overly-strict token-level diffs surface false positives. Mitigation: semantic-first assertions and canonicalization layer
Risk: Test maintenance cost as new features (e.g., multipath toolcalls) land. Mitigation: invest in clear contracts and helper libraries to build new seeds quickly
Risk: Nightly runtime cost. Mitigation: short fast PR checks + larger, resource-tagged nightly pool and retention policy for artifacts
next_steps: Stabilize PR harness and reduce flakiness threshold from 5% to 2% false positives
Add three additional golden seeds covering: interleaved tool-call, partial JSON NDJSON stream, and kv-cache-primed continuation
Wire failing runs into triage Slack channel and template an automated issue with artifacts
Schedule review with reliability and SDK teams for schema contracts and client expectations
